868615.name: Chabad Pucon
868615.note: COL, 10 Kislev 5769 (7 Dec 2008), 'חב"ד צ'ילה: נפתח מרכז חדש לזכות הקדושים הי"ד': after many years of work with Israelis under Rabbi Menashe Perman, 'בית חב"ד צ'ילה מקים כעת בית חב"ד נוסף בעיר פוקון שבדרום צ'ילה עבור ישראלים ותיירים בכלל' (Chabad of Chile is now setting up another Chabad House in Pucon, for Israelis and tourists), in memory of Gavriel Noach and Rivka Holtzberg, and 'בית חב"ד יחל לתפקד באופן מלא בחנוכה אי"ה וינוהל ע"י הרב אלימלך וגולדי פרמן' (it will be fully running by Chanukah, run by Rabbi Elimelech and Goldi Perman): Chanukah 5769 was 22-29 Dec 2008. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2009-04-01; Chaya Perman 'mentions a Chabad House in Pucon, about 500 miles south, that is popular with Israeli backpackers' (CrownHeights.info, 11 May 2011); its 'annual mega-seder' by 2014 (Chabad.org, 8 May 2014). Today General Urrutia 636.

119085.name: Or Jabad Day School
119085.note: Jabad Lubavitch de Venezuela, 'Educando a los pequeños - Preescolar Or Jabad' (chabad.org article 624166, published 10 Jan 2008): 'Éste nació gracias a la Sra. Chaya Perman' (Rabbi Moshe Perman's wife), who 'decidió fundar un preescolar para niños desde los 6 meses hasta los 6 años de edad', and 'A pesar de que tiene 30 años abierto, poco se sabe de él y de su historia' (open for 30 years): counted back, about 1978. Chabadpedia (Moshe Perman's page): after the first camp, he 'later' opened the Or Chabad schools in Caracas. Goldie Slavin (the Permans' daughter, wife of Rabbi Yosef Chaim Slavin) had then been at the school 10 years and 7 as director of its Hebrew department. It later moved to the community campus at Los Chorros (Nuevo Mundo Israelita: Or Jabad moved to the school's facilities with the UIC, keeping its independence). Medium: a round count back from one source. Its chabad.org listing is from the first directory (2004).

5175431.name: Chabad Playa Venao Panama
5175431.note: The earliest report found: before Pesach 2021, 'the Shliach for the Israeli community in Panama City, Rabbi Mendy Karniel sent 2 bochurim to the beachfront town of Playa Venao to distribute Seder foods' (COLlive, 2 Apr 2021; photos, ChabadInfo, 5 Apr 2021). Its chabad.org listing was made in late June 2021. Agreeing: 'Vor zwei Jahren kam ein weiteres in Playa Venao hinzu' and 'Vor zwei Jahren wurden sogar ein Chabad-Haus und eine Synagoge eröffnet' (two years ago another was added in Playa Venao; two years ago a Chabad house and a synagogue were even opened; Jüdische Allgemeine, 12 May 2023, 'Surfen im Paradies', https://www.juedische-allgemeine.de/juedische-welt/surfen-im-paradies), under Rabbi Yariv Klein, 'die treibende Kraft' of Panama's Chabad houses for travelers. High: two sources that agree.

people.name: Rabbi Yariv Klein
people.note: 'die treibende Kraft' (Jüdische Allgemeine, May 2023); with Lital Klein on its chabad.org listing

5274820.name: Chabad of Bocas del Toro
5274820.note: The earliest report found: 'Sukkos Mivtzoim in Bocas del Toro, Panama' (COLlive, 16 Oct 2020, photos only). Its chabad.org listing was made in Sept-Oct 2021. Its own site: 'נוסד על ידי הרב מוטי כהן והרבנית שרית כהן' (founded by Rabbi Moti Cohen and Rebbetzin Sarit Cohen; chabadbocas.org, no year). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2021-10-11. Jüdische Allgemeine (12 May 2023): Rabbi Yariv Klein decided in 2013 ('Nach einem Jahr, 2013') to open a Chabad house in Central America himself, 'Das erste Chabad-Haus eröffnete er an der Karibikküste in Bocas del Toro' (his first was in Bocas del Toro; no year), and 'bis vor zehn Jahren' there was no Chabad for travelers in Panama, Colombia or Costa Rica: so it may be older than this first report, but not before 2013.

5604369.name: Kolel Torah Panama
5604369.note: The earliest report found: 'The talmidim of the yeshiva gedola "Kollel Torah" in Panama, had a special visitor last week, Rabbi Hershel Schachter', welcomed by 'the talmidim-shluchim ... and the rosh yeshiva - Rabbi Menachem Mendel Shuchat, and the rav of the Ashkenazi community, shliach Rabbi Ahron Leib Laine' (ChabadInfo, 19 Dec 2022). 'Rabbi Mendy Shuchat, Rosh Yeshivas Chabad / Kolel Torah of Panama' (COLlive, 29 Mar 2023); 'Yeshiva Gedolah - Kolel Torah Panama' (COLlive, 25 Aug 2025); 'Kolel Torah Panama published its first edition of Seder Pesach Illuminated' (COLlive, 31 Mar 2026). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2022-10-25. Anash.org's 'Bochurim Shluchim Open Panama's New Yeshiva' (12 shluchim, modeled on the Caracas yeshiva) and 'Third Year of Kolel' would date it, but anash.org is out of reach here. Medium: the earliest mention found.

7338776.name: Jabad Monterrey
7338776.note: World Cup activities in July 2026 were led 'by Zalmy Srugo in Monterrey', a city 'home to active Chabad centers' (COLlive, 13 July 2026). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2026-07-09 (chabad.org's own record), so it existed by then. Medium: the earliest mention found (COLlive, 13 July 2026), days after its listing; Chabad may be older in Monterrey (Chabadpedia: Rabbi Zalman Leib Liberzon is a shochet and shliach in Monterrey's community, no year).

people.name: Zalmy Srugo
people.note: Rabbi Shneor Zalmen Srugo on its chabad.org listing

3764606.name: Casa Lubavitch Cartagena
3764606.note: In March 2015 there was no Chabad house yet: rabbinical students came for Pesach for the fifth year running and 'Since no kosher catering facilities exist in Cartagena, all of the food is prepared in Barranquilla' (Chabad.org, 31 Mar 2015). By Dec 2024 'the longer established Chabad house' (San Diego Jewish World, 25 Dec 2024). Today Carrera 1 #8-210, Bocagrande (Rabbi Saadia and Esti Globerman). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2017-10-25 (chabad.org's own record), so it existed by then. Range: after March 2015 (no Chabad house yet) and by 2017 (its chabad.org listing went up on 2017-10-25).

people.name: Rabbi Saadia Globerman
people.note: on its chabad.org listing, with Esti Globerman; start not found

4085561.name: Kosher Bakery - Morton's Bake house
4085561.note: A kosher bakery in Plaza San Francisco, Alto Boquete, now part of Chabad of Boquete's kosher catering (GoKosher). The bakery itself opened about 27 Oct 2013 (Panama Prattle, 1 Nov 2013: 'opened up 5 days ago', its owner Morton at the counter; no word of kashrus or Chabad), before Chabad came to Boquete (the Poliwodas, Aug 2016). Range: under Chabad after Aug 2016, by 2018 (its chabad.org listing went up on 2018-08-21).
